content: अभी [अभि -इ] €2 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To approach, come or draw near, go up to (with <ab>acc.</ab>) अस्मानत्तुमितोऽभ्येति <ls>Bk. 7. 84</ls>; <ls>Ki. 2. 54</ls>. .²2 To go along or after, follow, serve. .²3 .³({%a%}) To go into, enter; <ls>Bk. 5. 67</ls>; अवाङ्नरकमभ्येति <ls>Ms. 8. 75</ls>. .³({%b%}) To go over to, reach, arrive at; <ls>Me. 36</ls> <ab>v. l.</ab> .³({%e%}) To fall to oneʼs share, come to; नाऽविविदिषुमभ्येति सम्पद् रुरुदिषुं नरम् <ls>Bk. 7. 99</ls>. .²4 To get, meet with, fall into, suffer, undergo (said of good or bad things); कार्यं संसिद्धिमभ्येति <ls>Pt. 1</ls>.
